tools.name: search_encyclopedia
tools.description: Find metals, minerals, ingredients and materials, potions, gems, the milieux, animals, plants and creatures of Biomes and the reference pages of Hearth, Passage and Bearer by name (case- and accent-insensitive; exact names first, then prefixes, then substrings, aliases included). Returns each hit wi

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: The full data of one entry (a metal, mineral, ingredient, potion, gem, milieu, animal, plant, creature or reference page) by its id (from search_encyclopedia or list_entries): properties, lore, page url, embed_url.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: A page of one catalogue, filtered. Use it to answer "which minerals are cubic and gem-quality?", "legendary metals of the medieval era", "swamp ingredients with a fire essence". Combine with q for a name search inside the filter.

tools.name: random_entry
tools.description: One entry at random among those matching the filters: loot tables, "mineral of the day", a credible metal for a blacksmith, a foraging roll.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Every distinct value of each filterable field of a catalogue (categories, rarities, crystal systems, biomes, essences…) and its entry count.

tools.name: craft_rules
tools.description: The rules of the crafting system (characters, essences, extraction, brewing, gem cutting, socketing) as titled HTML sections.

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Published tracks of MGS Audio (music, ambiences, sound effects) with composer, album, moods, keywords, duration and page url. Metadata only: no audio file. "A battle theme" → genre: "Combat", type: "music"; "a forest ambience" → type: "ambience", genre: "Forest"; "something for a dungeon" → keyword:

tools.name: random_track
tools.description: One published track at random among those matching the filters.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: One track by id or slug, with its published alternative versions.

tools.name: list_composers
tools.description: Every composer with published tracks, most prolific first, with their page url.

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: Published albums with track count, page url and an embeddable player url.

tools.name: audio_taxonomy
tools.description: The vocabulary of the track filters: every genre, mood, era and keyword in use.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_encyclopedia" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
